code.purpose: The inlined example file and inline code.

components.name: Primary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 2.75rem; padding: 0 1.25rem; border-radius: 0.625rem; background: oklch(0.527 0.154 150.069); color: oklch(0.982 0.018 155.826); font-weight: 500; text-decoration: none; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: color-mix(in oklch, oklch(0.527 0.154 150.069) 88%, black); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(0.708 0 0); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 2.75rem; padding: 0 1.25rem; border-radius: 0.625rem; border: 1px solid oklch(0.922 0 0); background: transparent; color: oklch(0.145 0 0); font-weight: 500; text-decoration: none; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: oklch(0.97 0 0); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(0.708 0 0); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Nav link
components.css: .ds-nav-link { display: flex; align-items: center; min-height: 2.75rem; color: oklch(0.556 0 0); text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav-link:hover, .ds-nav-link[aria-current="page"] { color: oklch(0.145 0 0); }

narrative.overview: The site is a slip that names one file and tells you how to load it. Huge type, short lines, almost no prose. Dark default from shadcn preset b2YPlg. Green is only for the action you can press.
keyCharacteristics: Dark .dark by default, light :root via the header switch.
One reading axis. H1, one sentence, two buttons.

rules.name: The Action-Only Green Rule
rules.body: If it is not pressable, it is not green.

rules.name: The Filename-Is-The-Display Rule
rules.body: The H1 is the product name. Do not add a kicker above it.

rules.name: The Hairline-Or-Space Rule
rules.body: Pick a border or a gap. Do not stack both to fake a card.

dos: Do keep the home lede as One open Markdown file that teaches any AI your voice.
Do keep green on the primary action only.
Do cut a sentence rather than add a section.
donts: Don't mention AGENTS.md on home or load. FAQ and the spec may.
Don't restore zinc HSL 240 10% tokens or hsl(var(.
Don't nest cards or add a Why essay.
Don't put a kicker or eyebrow above the H1.
Don't add a generator, loader, account, or Supervised/Jeroen branding.
